task_type: production availability slider repair and release
requested_outcome: The public nearby-vacation slider always shows date-bound verified or last-known-good offers with prices, never ordinary catalog cards presented under an availability heading, and recovers automatically after a cache refresh.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co homepage nearby-vacation slider on desktop and 390-pixel mobile
authorization_boundary: Authorized to diagnose, change code, test, deploy the repair to the public VII site, and verify it live; unrelated product changes are excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared availability component failed publicly and the repaired detail must be checked across its full slider family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exact public-route verification, all affected date tabs, loading and recovery states, plus an independent release verdict.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly requested an immediate production correction.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires a frozen release identity, rollback point and verification of the exact deployed public version.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defect is visible in a responsive homepage rail and was reported by screenshot.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires inspected public screenshots on desktop and 390-pixel mobile, not code-only evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every restored availability card must expose a real price with the approved currency convention.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires visible prices formatted with the ₪ symbol and correct right-to-left geometry.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The banner is hidden but the cards still have no date-bound price or availability proof.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove catalog fallback cards from the availability rail and accept only verified offer snapshots for rendering.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every visible card on every enabled tab contains a price, selected dates and an available quote object.

predicted_rejections.rejection: An old browser session keeps the broken fallback after the server cache is healthy.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Version the client discovery cache and prevent refreshing responses from being persisted as last-known-good evidence.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A browser with a seeded stale fallback refreshes to verified cards without manual storage clearing.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The repair works for the first tab only and another date tab falls back to generic cards.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise every configured nearby-vacation period and shared holiday rail behavior.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All configured period endpoints and tab transitions either show verified priced offers or a bounded loading/recovery state, never generic cards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A deployment overwrites recent approved business-page fixes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Release only from the current production-aligned v581 worktree and preserve unrelated files and behavior.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Git diff contains only the availability cache repair and its tests, and the public business route still renders after deployment.

affected_family: app/components/home-live-deals.tsx nearby vacation and holiday modes
browser discovery cache persistence for availability rails
all configured nearby vacation date tabs in Hebrew and localized UI
desktop and 390-pixel mobile homepage slider rendering

sources.label: Last-known-good availability and background refresh product decision

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the route and component tests prove that refreshing responses cannot become visible availability cards, before build and deployment.
checks: Run the targeted availability rail tests.
Open a local or temporary public candidate with a forced refreshing response and verify no generic card rail appears.

attack_questions: Can a prior sessionStorage fallback still reappear after reload?
Can any date tab show cards without price or date-bound availability?
Does a supplier refresh failure erase the last verified snapshot?
Did the deployment regress the recent public business-detail fixes?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Public homepage screenshot and DOM inspection on the exact deployed release at desktop and 390-pixel mobile.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Endpoint matrix for every period, targeted automated tests, shared component checks and public tab transitions.

effectiveness.baseline: The public screenshot showed three ordinary catalog cards without prices beneath a background-refresh banner in an availability slider.
effectiveness.target: Zero generic catalog cards in availability rails, all visible offer cards priced and date-bound, and no manual browser-cache clearing required.
